overview_description.description:
Envoy transforms modern workplaces, challenging the status quo with products that make office life and work more meaningful. Envoy has redefined how offices interact with visitors and manage deliveries in over 13,000 locations around the globe while building products for a new era of workplace experience. Companies like Slack, Asana, Pinterest, and Warby Parker rely on Envoy to create an unrivaled first impression and keep their offices secure and compliant.

With more than 100,000 new sign-ins every day, Envoy Visitors empowers workplaces to create a warm welcome for guests while safeguarding their people, property, and ideas. Envoy Deliveries ensures that packages safely reach their recipients at work, without mailroom pile-ups or communication delays.

product.name: Envoy Workplace Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing workplace visitors, resources, communications, deliveries, and workplace presence across one or more locations.

product.name: Envoy Visitors
product.description: Visitor and contractor management software for digital registration, screening, approvals, check-in, badge printing, host notifications, and audit-ready onsite records.

product.name: Envoy Reservations
product.description: Resource booking software for reserving desks, conference rooms, and parking while providing live availability and workplace utilization data.

product.name: Envoy Emergency Notifications
product.description: An emergency and mass notification system that sends targeted, multi-channel alerts and tracks safety confirmations for employees and visitors onsite.

product.name: Envoy Deliveries
product.description: Mailroom management software that tracks workplace packages from receipt through pickup, with recipient notifications and secure collection records.

product.name: Envoy Screens
product.description: Digital signage software for centrally managing workplace displays, operational messages, safety communications, evacuation information, and emergency alerts.
